verdict.rationale: The evidence shows accounts and account numbers created and managed programmatically: Ramp spins up unique accounts per user, and multiple Account Numbers can be issued per Account. Customers are represented as Entities with API-exposed validations, and accounts sit at real partner banks with FDIC insurance reachable via IntraFi sweeps. Docs also state every API feature is available in Sandbox, with Simulation APIs for testing. The application-to-active lifecycle is not explicitly documented, and insurance is shown only through partner banks and IntraFi, so the story is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit account-creation endpoint docs, a documented end-to-end flow from application to active account (KYC/approval states), explicit FDIC coverage for standard accounts, and independent hands-on corroboration of sandbox parity for account opening.
